Browser DWG import & export

A local CAD experiment. Your saved LogEn projects and production app are unchanged.

Two racks. One ground location. A real DWG.

Read the included synthetic warehouse drawing, add three outlines, and download the edited DWG. All CAD processing runs on this device. Server connections are blocked on this page.

Use a copy of a small drawing in millimetres. This proof adds fixed test positions; it does not run the warehouse optimizer. Limit: 20 MB.

Ready · No AutoCAD or helper required for this experiment.
